title: Routing boundaries between sibling skills
description: Each boundary names two or three easily confused skills, the single English rule that decides the owner, and Vietnamese activation cues per skill. Cross-file checks (catalog membership, cue keys, SKILL.md mentions) live in tests/build/test_skill_routing.py.

vi_cues.description: Keys are exactly the skill IDs of this boundary; values are non-empty arrays of Vietnamese cues with diacritics.
